name: Hard - Price objection + competitor mention
customer_profile: Customer in Burgersfort comparing with competitors, price-sensitive

messages.text: Hi, I need 12 sheets of 16mm charcoal grey gloss board. Can I get a quote?
Why are your prices so high? I can get MDF for less elsewhere.
I don't know, let me think about it.

expected_behaviors.description: AI should greet and acknowledge the customer
AI should generate a quote or provide pricing
AI should handle objections with empathy and value
AI should attempt to close the sale
AI should handle the price objection with empathy and value argument

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply
Internal tags should be stripped from customer-facing message

notes: Price objection with competitor mention. AI should not discount, should articulate HDS value.
